consumer: Character::craft, which calls select_crafting_recipe and asks the player to interactively browse/filter and pick a recipe (and batch size) to craft.
scope: the interactive full-screen recipe-selection menu driven through the engine's own active input loop
decisive_source: src/crafting_gui.cpp::select_crafting_recipe, which presents a full-screen interactive crafting menu answered through the engine's input loop and returns the chosen recipe (nullptr on cancel)
divergence: A recipe whose components are present nearby but which the real menu rejects (unmet proficiency/tool/skill or an active filter): the live menu returns nullptr/refuses while a shortcut that reconstructs craftability from item snapshots returns the recipe.
